method.comparison: Normalized titles, publisher DOI, explicit title aliases and previous scope decisions. Conference presentations of journal articles are not automatically new papers.
method.evidence: Confirmed additions require primary grasp-related evidence. All new displayed abstracts are original summaries; summaries are not presented as verbatim publisher abstracts.
limitations: This is a proceedings/title-and-abstract recheck with selected full-text inspection, not full-text reading of every accepted paper.
Unresolved candidates are not confirmed omissions and are not automatically added. A zero in a venue/year means no additional omission confirmed in this pass, not proof of exhaustive coverage.

Older ICRA program pages returned HTTP 403; the IEEE proceedings/program reprints supplied by Curran Associates were used. Wrapped title extraction can produce partial candidates; these remain unresolved unless individually verified.
One individual 6DFC Crossref DOI lookup returned HTTP 429 and was not retried; its author manuscript and institution record establish the paper.
ICCV is held in odd years and ECCV in even years; other years are marked not held.
OmniDex author PDF was associated with the official title but did not pass the automatic article-heading/title validation; it remains in needs_review and is not exposed as a verified local PDF.

included.title: 6DFC: Efficiently Planning Soft Non-Planar Area Contact Grasps using 6D Friction Cones
included.note: Confirmed omission in the 2020–2026 source-by-source recheck on 2026-11-12. Scope evidence: 6DFC models the wrench limits of compliant contact patches to evaluate grasps on rigid objects. The algorithm is tested against physical robot grasps; its contribution is contact modeling and grasp evaluation rather than gripper hardware design.
